title: Measuring Changes In Choroidal Thickness Induced By Prototype Soft Contact Lenses Worn For 1 Hour
official: Measuring Changes In Choroidal Thickness Induced By Prototype Soft Contact Lenses Worn For 1 Hour
summary: The objective of the study is to evaluate the short-term change in choroidal thickness induced by 3 prototype soft contact lenses for people with myopia.

sites.f: Centre for Ocular Research and Education at the School of Optometry and Vision Science at Waterloo University
